facts.fact: Casual visitors may not intrude on a funeral or linger around an open grave.
facts.excerpt: Casual visitors to the cemetery, who are not members of a funeral procession or party, may not intrude upon a funeral party or loiter about an open grave.

facts.fact: Loud conversation and unapproved audio are prohibited.
facts.excerpt: Loud conversation or offensive language is not permitted.

facts.fact: Visitors may not sit or lean on monuments, markers and other cemetery structures.
facts.excerpt: No person or persons shall sit or lean on any cemetery structures

facts.fact: Treasure hunts and removal of artefacts are prohibited.

title: City of Savannah — conduct in municipal cemeteries
